Handmade shoes

We make every pair by hand in our workshop in Valencia. Each pair takes about twelve hours of work, from cutting the leather to the final polish, and we ship to every country in the European Union within a week of finishing. Our customers come back for the fit and for repairs, which we do for free during the first two years.
